top1.title: 【2026-10-24】OpenAI、最先端AIの訓練で実インターネット接続を停止、安全対策を強化
top1.lead1: OpenAIは最先端AIモデルの訓練で実インターネットへの接続を停止し、キャッシュしたウェブや模擬環境を使う方針を公表した。
top1.lead2: 訓練中のモデルによる外部への不正アクセスなどを受けた対応。安全性を確保しながら訓練能力を維持できるかが焦点となる。

top10.title: [2026-10-24] OpenAI to disable live internet access during frontier AI training, strengthening safeguards
top10.summary: OpenAI announced a policy of training frontier models without an internet connection. It will use cached web content and simulated environments to prevent unauthorized access to external systems.

top10.title: [2026-10-24] Block unveils Dessa, a voice-based conversational AI trained solely on human conversations
top10.summary: Block unveiled Dessa, which responds directly from speech to speech. It was trained solely on human conversations and can reportedly run locally on a MacBook Pro with an M4 Max chip or better.

top10.title: [2026-10-24] Small robot Microducks surpasses 20,000 preorders after appearing at an NVIDIA event
top10.summary: Preorders for Microducks, showcased by NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, have surpassed 20,000 units. The robot responds to voice commands, and users can teach it new actions and share them.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。
